summary: Tracks which checkpoint is next and counts laps, by distance rather than trigger colliders.
overview: Drop it on any racer with an ordered list of checkpoints. It is distance-based rather than trigger-based, so there is no collider setup track-side, and it always requires the NEXT expected checkpoint — which is what stops a racer cutting the course and still scoring a lap.
useCases: Lap counting and position in a race.
Driving a lap and checkpoint HUD.

params.tuning: Order matters — it is the ordering that enforces the route.
Too small and a fast car passes through between frames and never registers the checkpoint.

gotchas.title: A fast racer can tunnel past a small radius
gotchas.body: Checks happen per frame at a position, so at high speed the racer can be past the radius before it is ever tested. Make the radius generous.
